description: Implement fixes to prevent stale prior-task answers: make minion delegation reminders non-user context without mandatory acknowledgement, gate hints on current prompt/tool count, raise/disable prompt length default, fix spawn_bg wording, stop OM suggested-response injection/stickiness, add recency guard for active guidance publication, and filter OM out of minion subsessions. Add regression tests and run lint/test/typecheck.

comments.text:
Implemented and committed as 79695c4 (`fix: prevent stale delegation and OM guidance`).

Changes:
- Minions delegation reminders now append to `before_agent_start` system prompt, not synthetic user messages.
- Removed mandatory acknowledgement wording and fixed default wording to use `spawn` with `tasks` arrays; raised default prompt length threshold to 4000 and gated length against current prompt only.
- Filtered `pi-om-extension` out of minion subsessions alongside recursive `pi-minions` filtering.
- OM no longer injects `<om-suggested-response>` into system prompt or compaction context; suggested response remains diagnostic in status/observations.
- OM clears stale active guidance when a newly observed user task lacks replacement active fields, and guards published active guidance against cursors older than the latest user task.

Validation:
- `npm run test -w @solvedbydev/pi-minions -- --run` passed.
- `npm run test -w @solvedbydev/pi-om-extension -- --run` passed.
- `npm run typecheck -w @solvedbydev/pi-minions` passed.
- `npm run typecheck -w @solvedbydev/pi-om-extension` passed.
- `npm run lint -w @solvedbydev/pi-minions` passed.
- `npm run lint -w @solvedbydev/pi-om-extension` passed.
- Full `npm run typecheck` passed.
- Full `npm run lint` and `npm run test` are blocked by pre-existing/unrelated `packages/pi-hashline-readmap` workspace problems from the dirty tree (`package.json` modified and untracked `packages/pi-hashline-readmap/`), not by this change.
